summary_en: BCPE Neon Cayman LP submitted a corrected tender offer filing on September 3, 2026, to reflect that a 3.93% shareholder (1,290,000 shares) entered into a commitment agreement to tender all holdings.
title_en: Notification of Correction Regarding Announcement of Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of baudroie, inc. (Stock Code: 4413) and Correction of Tender Offer Commencement Notice
translation_en_brief:
BCPE Neon Cayman LP (the tender offer bidder) submitted a corrected tender offer filing on September 3, 2026. The correction was necessitated by a commitment agreement entered into on August 28, 2026, between the bidder and Takeshi Kobayashi, the fourth-largest shareholder of baudroie, inc., whereby Mr. Kobayashi agreed to tender all of his ordinary shares in the company to the ongoing tender offer.

The agreement covers 1,290,000 shares representing 3.93% of the company's issued share capital (excluding treasury shares). This commitment constitutes a material change to the circumstances disclosed in the original tender offer notice and filing submitted on August 19, 2026. The original filing had itself been subject to a corrective amendment on August 27, 2026. This September 3 correction reflects the newly concluded commitment agreement with a significant shareholder, thereby amending the tender offer documentation and public notice of commencement filed on August 19, 2026.
